story.text: 27 July 2026 — the [[Improbable Engine]] went from plan to running instrument in one day, built against the live local farm and aligned to the Lattice Garden research as it surfaced.

The day's walk: the five labs ground-truthed; the geometry study found the torus is the flat vertex codex closed shut, and that five labs plus the knowledge hearth equal the [[Six Strands]] of the lattice basis — see [[Lattice Torus Geometry]]. The first Three.js form went live the same afternoon: live wiki pages as stars, sitemap links as the woven graph, click-walks as saveable constellations.

Feedback shaped it in rounds: the fold-slider seam bug found and fixed, constellations made saveable and exportable, the piece named, and five 5x5 crystal plaquettes seated in the torus void — one ground-state crystal per lab, ringing the hearth.

Then the garden reframed the work: the alignment research names the wiki's role as edge structure, not a sixth node, and the Shared Lexicon Lattice proposal states the visualisation of the link structure is the exhibit. The engine is that exhibit, running. By evening the garden's own sites were seated on the torus directly — the research corpus as stars on the geometry it described — and the bundle was published to this site's assets folder so anyone can run the engine on their own grid: [[Run Your Own Grid]].

Root facts were re-verified against the garden the same evening: groundstates, 28 to 31 January 2027, silent green Kulturquartier, curated by Barbara Cueto, RFC 40. Full provenance travels in the bundle — see [[Engine Chronicle]].
